question: How many units of the 'Cobolt Nimbus' did we sell in completed orders in 2025? Give the product's ID and name with the unit count.

sql_attempts.sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM products AS p JOIN order_items AS oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE p.product_name = 'Cobalt Nimbus' AND o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name LIMIT 500
